notes.title: Early Access v3.4 Map update and extra features

notes.title: Patch note 3.0.1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Thank you so much for all your support [/b][/h1]

Hello everyone,

The Unknown region early access version 3 has been out for more than 3 weeks now, and I have Received a Good response from you!

Thank you so much for playing and streaming Unknown region _ Early access version 3

Since the release, I have been working on some changes and bug fixes. Here is a list of what this Patch includes:


[h1][b]Implementation of vendor management 
[/b][/h1]

The new trade system was implemented on the map with new locations. Once you find the traders you'll be able to buy sell items.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/e7b95fd99ee8227d4b8157309f900d30e6b56672.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/35ec309aa90db52aafba5e1f5a7894e681c75db8.png[/img]


[h1][b]NEW AI BASE OWNERS [/b][/h1]

The new AI base owners are now available in new locations on the map. Now you can raid their bases and loot them, but this is what you can expect if you try it out 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/4511c67131d43b89c393a87f8f21d72af1adc94d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/1bf18fc13247a4d23693e68f289d2043dd6fa36e.gif[/img]

[h1][b]CHANGELOG[/b][/h1]

[b]-[/b] Day-night cycle speed degraded 
[b]-[/b] Reduced the darkness of the night
[b]- [/b]Dead AI body despawn time increased
[b]- [/b]Improved models and textures of the landscape and building blocks
[b]-[/b] Added 20 scrap metals as starting items.
[b]-[/b] Added 3 melee AI hunters to the AI group.
[b]-[/b] 4 new locations - AI bases and vendor locations.
[b]-[/b] New enemies- 3 new melee hunters
[b]-[/b] Extra slots in the backpack, clothing items, and workbench.
[b]-[/b] implemented user interface sounds.

[h1][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h1]

- Issue with consumables audio 
- Axe and pickaxe do not delete on quick slot after destroying 
- crosshair visibility on the opened inventory
- Save system not loading items after a number of saves
- Weapon workbench and punji sticks not saving 
- Weapon swapping not working correctly
- Swapped weapons not firing

notes.title: Early Access v3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/6fdb51497924a7e385b258faca98aa24f41bfa69.png[/img]

Hello survivors! I'm happy to announce that Unknown Region Early Access version 3 has just launched and is ready to play! The latest version comes up with a new survival system and a new map.

[h1][b]IMPLEMENTATION OF BOW AND ARROWS[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/809bf8e92315ec00c65501e143d6c014e929f558.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/7824b777ec8deedbdc7b44a0767febc0747011e3.gif[/img]




[h1]IMPLEMENTATION OF A NEW DYNAMIC WEATHER SYSTEM [/h1]
The new dynamic weather system comes with 8 weather presets, They randomly change during the game.  Weather presets include clear sky, foggy, clouded, medium clouded, rainy, thunder rain, and thunderstorm.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/f64f419645516e6190b67623f219bbd54a1c880b.gif[/img]

[h1][b]NEW BASE BUILDING SYSTEM INCLUDING TRIANGLE FOUNDATION AND WALLS[/b][/h1]
This new base building system will be available from your building plan menu as soon as you craft and hold it.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/4ac3308cb4dbf3131d4762297199b73640ceabba.gif[/img]

[h1]UPGRADE WOOD TO STONE AND STONE TO METAL[/h1]

New base upgrading options will be available in your hammer menu.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/4fddd26471f32d7107da13b64284bcdc59911fbd.gif[/img]


[h1][b]NEW BUILD PARTS, BEEHIVE, LAMP,  DEER HEAD DECOR  AND MORE[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]DOOR AND STORAGE LOCK SYSTEM[/b][/h1]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/70b207f1acaacea24df1c40dae9035bf496bf320.gif[/img]

[h1][b]ADDED GRENADES AND MOLOTOV COCKTAIL [/b][/h1]

These are the new clothes available within this new update. Some clothing items can be found in the world, but these clothes will only allow minimal carry weights.  You will need to hunt animals to find hides to craft clothes with advanced weight limits.

[h1][b]NEW BACKPACK[/b][/h1]
The new backpack has different weight limits and inventory layouts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/b124708b0bae20830d9f718de80e185c5bf47d81.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/711f66523cfcfa4afec32bbb8d973bb035e241c3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/16d5baf99582af4913efca9b8598062ecd76fb59.png[/img]

[h1][b]CHANGES TO THE SAVE SYSTEM 
[/b][/h1]

The new save system automatically saves the game every 3 minutes but also you can save games to slots and can load them into singleplayer or multilayer. This will prevent the loss of your loot once you die so make sure you save the game every time when you can.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/18e278db53de43ec8e41fe02b406685f1ce67db3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/c4e277d8bc5577674641280879fb8e63af2f1a8c.png[/img]

[h1][b]WILDLIFE[/b][/h1]

To make the unknown region more immersive and alive, I have added more wildlife to the game! These new AI now attack every base building part, and each AI has different damage values. To defend your base from these creatures place punji sticks around the base or upgrade to stone or metal. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/9d7df7faff20ea0ad88eec5cf6c57ef6c745299a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/894f6db875019dd47fd7e745a43f58ff5375f04e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/9bd8f2fca420f109a7a6ac4814421793c02fa25b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/3c319aff88c27f41de39493d49bee94022349060.png[/img]

[h1][b]NEW COMPANION AI[/b][/h1]
This new German shepherd dog can be found somewhere on the map and he will be following you around the world.  If you lose your furry friend he will teleport back to you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/ed2c178af7ab46843070ea192b489ac97a1a9f04.png[/img]


[h1][b]NEW CREATURES [/b][/h1]
These are the new creatures and shooters will spawn in random locations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/537ff081dc70242e50c9ce437172cf5f83be5614.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/b06248cee98f240444fd7364ad6857168aa7fe0c.png[/img]


Thanks so much for reviewing my latest update.  I'm a solo developer, and I continuously work on updating and improving Unknown Region.  I hope to bring the dedicated servers soon. shoot me a message on discord with any suggestions.  I'm really happy to bring you this update and hope you enjoy playing  Unknown Region.

notes.title: Update 2.0.0
notes.content:
1. Implementation of a new map. The new map has greater performance than the previous one.
   It has many abandoned houses, barn areas to explore.
   new AI randomly spawning in main areas of the map. These are the most dangerous AI characters, so 
   be careful: Gang shooters, bears, wolves, fox, wild boar, wild tribes, snakes, spiders, zombies, and 
   creatures.
   
2. Addition a new day-night cycle with a dynamic weather system. 
3. New abandoned houses, barn fields, and lakes.
4. Addition new items to the loot spawn list.
5. Added new zombie and creature AI characters and removal of some creatures, for example, elephants, rhino, polar bear, zebra, and grenade shooters. 
6. Added random ammo option to the guns, now guns spawn with random ammo.
7. Beautiful new scenery throughout the game. 
8. Fixed weapon not attaching to FP hands when a new client connects.
9. Fixed stamina not reducing on start.
10.Fixed issue with resource collision.
11.Removed vehicles from multiplayer, vehicles available only for singleplayer, multiplayer vehicles has 
    few bugs so once I fix I will add the vehicles for multiplayer.

notes.title: Patch note 1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38442022/48751b8d54b28b6587fe8f659cc3b2103c8aa26b.png[/img]

1. Added map option, allows players to know their location.  Players can add destination marker to easily navigate. 
2. Introduction of a new vehicle system, allows players to flip cars if they happen to get stuck. Just press the Z key and this will prevent any frustrating moments.
3. Addition of new vehicles.
4. All vehicles now have the ability to kill animals. But it depends on the vehicle speeds, lower speed won't make any damage to the AI.
5. Reduce overpowered AI, for example now raccoon, snakes will only damage 5. 
6. Fixed crafting list empty when interacting with the actor.
7. Added random ammo to the guns, now guns will spawn with random ammo.
8. Added multiple items to the spawners.
9. Changed the main menu UI and loading screen.
10. Added more landscape details, lakes, drinking zones, and smooth landscapes to let players drive anywhere on the map easily.
11. Fix the vehicle audio issue was not able to decrease the audio. 
12. Removed some AI and replace some of them with Zombies.
13. Fixed melee impact sound not working.
14. Decreased player health, hunger, and thirst timers, without having any food or water, can survive  25 minutes.
